Our eternal gratitude to the Vet Support team

When we brought our Pingo to Vet Support from another emergency service, we were experiencing one of the most desperate moments of our lives. He had been brutally attacked by a much larger dog and arrived needing urgent care.
Pingo is not just a dog. He is part of our family, our companion, our love, our four-legged son. And at that moment, our greatest fear was losing him.
From the moment we arrived, we were received with a welcome that we will never forget. I want to thank everyone, without exception: reception, nursing, technicians, X-ray team, hygiene and all the professionals who were involved, directly or indirectly, in the care of our Pingo.
Each one, in their own way, offered us affection, respect, attention, competence and humanity. In the midst of fear, tears and anguish, we found wonderful people who cared for him with dedication and also cared for us.

Today, being able to look at Pingo and see him alive, fighting, and recovering is an indescribable emotion. Our gratitude will be eternal because you were part of a moment when his life hung by a thread.
We believe that God placed each professional on this team in our path.
May God bless every hand that cared for Pingo, every professional who dedicated themselves, every person who welcomed us, and all those who, in some way, contributed to him having a new chance.
Thank you, Vet Support. You didn't just save an animal's life. You saved a member of our family and restored hope to our hearts.
With all our affection, respect, and eternal gratitude.
Marly and family ❤️
Very good experience with a caring and well-prepared team.

My dog ​​received excellent care and lots of love and attention at all times. The staff was extremely attentive and careful, always concerned about his well-being. I was so happy to know that, in addition to all the necessary care, they even took him for a walk. These little details make all the difference! ❤️🐶

I am very grateful to the entire team for their care and attention. I highly recommend them!
a place full of affection

Run away, this is a place that will suck the life out of you. My dog ​​got sick and the vet recommended admitting her to this place. Besides the exorbitant daily rate, they even charged for the food (rice and chicken) R$ 40.00 per portion. NOTHING is included in the daily rate, not medication, not IV fluids, not GLOVES, nothing! They kept scaring me, saying that my dog ​​couldn't be without oxygen, and they charged R$900.00 per day for oxygen, plus all the medications. She was in a cage with a loose tube in her snout. The result was 36 hours of hospitalization and a bill of R$ 7,000.00!
It's utter madness. I took her out of this trap and put her in a proper clinic. She's still hospitalized, but at a fair price because I'm not refusing to pay, but being robbed is outrageous.
Don't bring your animals here.

I want to express my immense gratitude to the entire medical staff and everyone who works at this hospital for the immense love, care, and dedication they showed my Meg. Unfortunately, it wasn't possible to deliver her alive! I know how competent and attentive they were. I am extremely grateful to everyone and highly recommend this hospital.

I would like to register my profound dissatisfaction with the service provided by this institution. Unfortunately, my experience with the staff was extremely negative, especially at a time of such emotional fragility. I felt no empathy, support, or humanity from any of the professionals who attended to me; all demonstrated a cold and unfriendly attitude.

Furthermore, visiting hours are extremely limited and inadequate, allowing only 15 minutes within a single time slot. I consider this restriction excessive, especially when compared to my previous experience at another veterinary clinic where my dog ​​was hospitalized. On that occasion, there was an appropriate and welcoming space for visits; I could see her whenever necessary, and the staff organized all the support structure to ensure she remained comfortable during those times. The veterinarians at that institution were remarkably humane, empathetic, caring, and attentive.

Another episode that caused me enormous indignation was the way I was informed about my dog's death. The professional responsible for the call did not clearly communicate the death and only mentioned that the situation had worsened. Because of this, my husband had to go to the clinic twice, as I didn't initially accompany him, unaware that she had already passed away. Later, he had to return to pick me up so I could say goodbye to her.

The veterinarian who made this contact was, unfortunately, the most unpleasant professional I encountered there, although, in general, all the appointments were marked by a lack of sensitivity. Her attitude seemed extremely inhumane and inappropriate in such a delicate situation.

I am speechless to describe the disgust I felt. I have never received such poor veterinary care, especially considering that I traveled approximately 220 kilometers from my city seeking proper care for my dog.

I leave this experience with a feeling of abandonment and an absolute lack of empathy from the entire team.

Excellent service.

Attentive, caring, ethical.

I recommend them.

A place of extreme trustworthiness. I needed to leave my little one hospitalized there, I live 6 hours away, I went based on a recommendation and my daughter received the best care. I highly recommend them! They are attentive and gave me all the support and peace of mind I needed.

My cat Julie was hospitalized there for two days to improve her kidney function. The entire Vet Support team, from reception to the medical staff, was super attentive, helpful, and very caring with my Juju. This is the second time I've admitted one of my cats, and I recommend the clinic for the attentive service they provide.

My dog ​​needed a blood transfusion and received excellent care, from reception to veterinary treatment. I received photos; she was very well treated, and thank God everything went well. She was only there for 24 hours, but I could see the care and excellent service from everyone. I recommend the clinic!

Unfortunately, my experience with this clinic was extremely painful. My daughter's dog passed away during treatment, and, in addition to the loss itself, I felt the treatment was very dehumanized at a time of immense suffering for our family.

I have had contact with other veterinary ICUs and services, and the difference in reception, communication, and sensitivity was very noticeable. We expected more care, empathy, and respect in such a delicate situation.

In my opinion, anyone who values ​​the emotional well-being of their family and humane care for their animals should consider looking elsewhere.

I needed to hospitalize my elderly dog ​​for gallbladder surgery. Everything went well; the clinic, veterinarians, and staff kept me informed of every step and how he was recovering.
In addition, the care and affection they showed him every day, including during the post-operative period at home, was evident.

I recommend the clinic and the professionals.

My Nina was hospitalized for treatment of refractory immune-mediated thrombocytopenia and received excellent care. We were very worried, as it was her first hospitalization, and I confess that I left there a little more relieved, as everyone at the clinic is extremely careful, attentive, and polite.
Dr. Nicolas, the coordinator of the veterinary team, was always available and explained all the steps during the visits, as did Dr. Larisse. The nursing staff and reception team were all top-notch. They sent photos of Nina during her hospitalization, and we were never without news about her, which reassured us. I will definitely recommend the clinic!
My little one needed to be hospitalized. Thank you for the care and dedication you showed her.
A wonderful team that took great care of Melzinha. Thank you all.

I've needed veterinary care for 3 of my dogs. The treatment is excellent. Fair price. They treat our furry children with so much love and respect!! I am very grateful to them for taking such good care of my children!!
An extraordinary and extremely competent team. They took care of my Bernese Mountain Dog with so much love and quality! She had surgery and was already doing great the next day.

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! ⭐
We are very happy with your recognition. We remain dedicated to providing the best care to our patients and their owners. Count on us! 🐾 …

Thank you so much for the 5 stars! ⭐
It's a great satisfaction to know that our work is making a difference. We remain committed to providing excellent service and taking great care of each patient. 🐾 …

I needed specific ICU services with mechanical ventilation for my pet. Even at 11:00 PM, they responded promptly, received my pet, and cared for me and her with all the love and affection... a completely humanized and respectful service during this time.
She passed away, and the immense affection from the entire team at all times, including the thoughtful letter to me as if it were from my pet...
Gratitude to everyone... Maduzinha and I thank you.

Our dog had an accident and needed surgery, and our veterinarian recommended this place for hospitalization and surgery. We found the service and all the care they gave her to be excellent, and we are very grateful!

Vetsupport is a veterinary hospital that stands out as a true example of dedication, professionalism, and love for animals. From the first appointment, it's possible to perceive the care and attention given to both the animal and its owners. They perform relevant exams, such as POCUS, right upon admission and during shifts, with precise case management. In addition, the medical report at each shift reveals the humanized care provided.

The team demonstrates a high level of technical expertise, and the reception staff are extremely caring!
The professionals are very attentive and competent, and they took care of my cat with great affection.
My dog ​​stayed at Vet Support for a few days, and the team is very well-prepared and available to help with questions and decisions!
Excellent service! They saved my cat.

My dog ​​Lua and I were welcomed and cared for with utmost zeal, expertise, and attention. The entire team involved was very kind and efficient. The veterinarians who have been treating Lua for a long time had all the necessary information and were able to monitor and make observations that benefited Lua. I am immensely grateful for all the care provided, which made it possible to save Lua's life and allow her to return home. May God always bless everyone who helped us win this battle. God be with you.

Thank you so much for the 5 stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 💙🐾
Your feedback is very important to us and motivates us to continue offering quality care, with affection and dedication to our patients and their owners. You can always count on our team! ✨ …

A very positive experience, similar to my previous stay (about 4-5 years ago).
The clinic staff were very attentive and competent. I highly recommend them.
Excellent service, dedication to the pets, I loved it!
We were all treated very well, both my dog, who has already been hospitalized three times at Vet Suporte, and us, the loving owners. Thank you for all the affection and care!

Great place, I highly recommend it!
I was treated and received very well, my dog, the main one, received total attention, they solved the problem, great professionals, polite and welcoming!! Because entrusting someone with the health or life of someone we love is no joke!!! I recommend it!!! 🫶🏽
Great place, clean and very beautiful environment, well-trained staff, attentive professionals – a place I highly recommend for taking our four-legged companions 🫶🏽 …

My puppy was hospitalized at this clinic and I am so grateful. The service is impeccable, from reception to the care in the ICU. During such a delicate time, I was treated with empathy, respect, and great professionalism. Thank you for everything, Vet Support team.

Vet Support is a welcoming place, with extremely friendly, attentive, and dedicated professionals.
Pleasant, clean, and welcoming environment.
I left my Shih Tzu with them and received updates the entire time he was there.
I recommend them!

🐾 Immense gratitude to Vet Support! 🐾✨
Once again, our dogs needed urgent care, and we found warmth, professionalism, and lots of love. Donatelo underwent delicate surgery and, thanks to the team's dedication, is now recovering full of life.
Throughout the entire process, we received attention, affection, and information that reassured us. The environment is organized, clean, and full of incredible professionals who treat our pets like true members of the family.
Donatelo and Clarinha thank you from the bottom of our hearts for all the care and protection. 💕
We also leave here our BIG THANK YOU! May God bless each and every one of you!

Despite the difficult situation
We were very well taken care of (me and my little dog)
The staff were super attentive and careful, I am eternally grateful for the service I received from the moment I arrived until I left!

Excellent clinic with welcoming and qualified professionals.
I highly recommend it.

My dog ​​needed emergency surgery and received excellent care from the entire team. The service was outstanding; they explained the surgery, exams, and post-operative care from the very beginning.

During my dog's hospitalization, the team constantly sent me updates on his health status.

Hello Alessandra!
Thank you for the 5 stars and for your trust in our work. We are very happy with your recognition.

You can always count on us to take care of the lovely Fabricio!

I am a veterinarian and I have known the ICU since the beginning with Dr. Andreza. My dogs and all my patients are always referred there when they need hospitalization. The team is absolutely wonderful, and all problems can be resolved very well through communication. They have saved many of my patients and pets, and I have immense affection and gratitude for them. THANK YOU TEAM!
My dog ​​was treated super well, I highly recommend her! ❤️

The staff, from reception to the veterinarians, were very polite and helpful.
The hospital was clean and well-ventilated!
I really liked the service, I highly recommend it!!!

Vet Support is an excellent hospital! The place and staff are welcoming and attentive, and the service is incredibly humane! The reception is excellent, the nurses are super caring, and the veterinarians are amazing – the whole team is top-notch! You can trust your pets to this hospital, because they are wonderful! During my daughter's stay, I received photos and videos, and you can see how much they care about our pets... Thank you everyone, you made all the difference in my daughter's life!

Highly competent, honest, sensitive, and kind professionals!
They saved our little dog!!!

My dog ​​needed to be hospitalized in the Vet Support ICU, and I was extremely satisfied with all the care she received. From the first contact, I was very well informed about her condition, the procedures, and each step of the treatment. The team was attentive, careful, and always willing to help, both with her needs and my questions.
The affection and professionalism of everyone was evident. The service is impeccable! I left there with a lot of confidence and gratitude. I will definitely return and recommend them without hesitation. 🧡

Vet Support's service is truly exceptional; they have a great team of intensivists, nurses, and attendants. Bud was hospitalized for 12 days in critical condition, but they managed to reverse his critical state, and today he is at home, recovering more each day. 🥰 …
